item.title: Anecdotes for Constitution Museum
item.description:
B. R. Ambedkar and the Surprising Call to Speak (17 December 1946)#

On 17 December 194G, in the midst of intense and formative deliberations of the Constituent Assembly of India, Dr B. R. Ambedkar found himself speaking under entirely unexpected circumstances. The debate centred on the “Objectives Resolution” introduced by Jawaharlal Nehru on 13 December, which laid out the guiding aims and principles for the future Constitution of India. ([constitutionofindia.net])
